The braced token in a recorded template is the name of the JavaScript expression interpolated at the call site, not a path parameter's name: the method, the route and the resolved handler (`backend_app.routers.signal_trace.get_signal`, `router.get('/signals/{signal_id}')`) are byte-identical either side of this re-record, and the handler's own parameter is still `signal_id`. The local was renamed when the page shell was rebuilt on the nine-stage projection (commits 990f8d6, 08f74de, adbd4b5 — spec tasks 21.4a, 21.4b, 21.5), which did not re-record this baseline. Because `path_template` is part of an entry's identity, a rename reads as one removal plus one addition rather than as a field change.
